name: com.lingkyn.quality-tiers.unity
description: Thin Unity adapter for the Lingkyn Quality Tiers Core: an accepted tier applied through three explicit seams (IXrDisplayControl for refresh rate and render scale, IFoveationControl for foveation level, IRendererAssetSwitch for a bound UniversalRenderPipelineAsset and Unity quality level), each with LESSON-004 fail-closed diagnostics on every by-name or optional resolution (display.unresolved, capability.unsupported.degraded, renderer.asset.unbound, settings.unresolved, adaptive_performance.unresolved); an injectable device-capability probe and fakes for the display, foveation, and renderer seams so tests assert exactly what was requested and what was reported applied; a frame-time sampler reporting measured frame time as plain data with no comfort or certification claim; and the Settings hook (IQualityOptionSource) mapping a user-facing quality option's raw value to a select_tier intent, with no reference to any Settings type.
